thesis: Doug Ostrover explains that he did not initially choose leverage finance, but rather was moved into the junk bond group by his employer after a regulatory change outlawed his previous focus on Industrial Revenue Bonds. He describes this transition as pure luck that occurred in 1986 or 1987 when his firm, formerly E.F. Hutton, moved him across the street to compete for market share against the dominant firm Drexel.
